about_the_game:
Master The Blade

You are the Sword: a sentient blade on a quest to find your Maker and to uncover the meaning of your life. This narrative platformer combines unique swordplay with puzzle-based exploration, inviting you to reflect while fighting to survive.

A World of Mystery

Enter the depths of an insane castle filled with puzzles, secret passageways, and unique mechanics. Nostalgic soul of classic platformers meets modern design that challenges your curiosity and imagination.

Defy Your Limits

Step into the world of The Lone Sword and carve through the mystery. Talk to fellow machines and slice through your enemies. Unbound by gravity, what will bring you down?

Unique Gameplay Features:

  • The Sword is the Hero: Experience gameplay where the Sword is not just a weapon but the heart of the story—each swing and movement reflects your mastery and purpose.

  • Puzzle-Based Exploration: Traverse a castle, solving puzzles and uncovering secrets as you progress through a narrative-rich world.

  • Your entire body is dangerous: Slice through enemies, pick their weak spots, and don't let them hit back!

  • Evocative Minimalism: art direction defined by bold shapes and striking colors, free from visual noise.

  • A Mechanical Fable: Immerse yourself in a whimsical and weird tale that explores themes of identity, creation, and purpose.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5, AMD FX
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulcan-capable GPU with 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04, SteamOS 3.0, Zorin OS 18 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (4th gen), AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050, Radeon RX 460, Intel Xe/Arc Graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: The Lone Sword is a narrative platformer where YOU are the weapon. As a living Sword, embark on a journey to find your Maker. Explore the Castle, solve physics puzzles, master the blade in aerial swordfight, and reflect on your purpose in this emotionally rich adventure.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish - Latin America
